payload.body: You tend to know what you like without treating the preference as a problem to solve. Your clothes, relationships, art, pleasures, or standards may not match what other people expect, but you do not need every choice to become a statement. You usually understand that taste does not require a defense. Other people often become more honest about their own wants around you.
payload.astroHint: Lilith trine Venus can make unconventional tastes and desires easy to accept as part of who you are.
